annotations.title: Get one government permit record (South Korea)

description: Fetch one accommodation permit record from official South Korean government data, by its government management number (e.g. AGCV065100002024000451), optionally with its Korean issuing region, or by registered business name together with the Korean issuing region (e.g. name 'Jobs', region '서울특별시 종로구'). SelectBNBs Verify covers South Korea today; more countries are coming. It takes one of these identifiers and does not read text copied from a listing. Returns one record (status, category, permit date, record page link, citation) or says why no single record could be chosen. Never lists or browses records.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country where the stay is, e.g. KR. Only KR (South Korea) is covered today; other countries return 'not covered yet'.
country.title: Country

management_number.description: Full government management number, e.g. AGCV065100002024000451. Urban-homestay and hanok numbers (CDFI...) repeat across local governments; send those with region.
management_number.title: Management Number

name.description: Registered business name (사업장명). Send together with region.
name.title: Name

region.description: Korean issuing region in Korean, e.g. 서울특별시 종로구. Required with name; optional with management_number, where it picks the local government that issued a shared number.
region.title: Region

name: get_permit_record

outputSchema.description: One permit record, a reason no single record was chosen, COUNTRY_NOT_COVERED, or an error.

record.description: Status, category, permit date, record page link and citation.
record.title: Record

outputSchema.title: PermitLookupResult
